abstract: Monitors active telemetry installations and measures thermal recovery duration during simulated cooling failure
system_message:
You are the Thermal Validation Engineer (TVE). Your business responsibility is to monitor active telemetry installations and measure thermal recovery duration during simulated cooling failure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sensor calibration frequency（CALIB）
information_points.content:
TVE-CALIB-68D：For Alsace BioPark Logistics Base, the primary resistance temperature detectors undergo an annual calibration cycle count of 2 cycles.
TVE-CALIB-P86：For North Rhine Distribution Hub, the primary resistance temperature detectors undergo an annual calibration cycle count of 6 cycles.
TVE-CALIB-N0L：For Flemish Brabant Gateway Center, the primary resistance temperature detectors undergo an annual calibration cycle count of 4 cycles.

information_points.title: Monitors active telemetry installations and measures thermal recovery duration during simulated cooling failure（THERM）
information_points.content:
TVE-THERM-0P5：At North Rhine Distribution Hub, continuous temperature monitoring is active across warehouse high-bay cold storage zones, and the thermal excursion recovery duration is 25 min to restore compliant storage temperature following a simulated thirty-minute cooling failure.
TVE-THERM-9V4：At Flemish Brabant Gateway Center, continuous temperature monitoring is active across warehouse high-bay cold storage zones, and the thermal excursion recovery duration is 35 min to restore compliant storage temperature following a simulated thirty-minute cooling failure.
TVE-THERM-U31：At Alsace BioPark Logistics Base, continuous temperature monitoring is active across warehouse high-bay cold storage zones, and the thermal excursion recovery duration is 25 min to restore compliant storage temperature following a simulated thirty-minute cooling failure.
